entities.summary: Goga Bitadze is a Georgian professional basketball player for the Orlando Magic of the National Basketball Association (NBA). Listed at 6 ft 11 in (2.11 m) and 250 pounds (110 kg), he plays the center and power forward positions. He was drafted 18th overall by the Indiana Pacers in the 2019 NBA draft.
